title: Yellow Yakimono Irish Cornmeal Grill
description: A savory and crumbly Irish dish featuring fine yellow cornmeal, grilled to perfection on a cedar plank, with a rich umami flavor, perfect for a monsoon evening, this recipe is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, salt, and black pepper.
Add the buttermilk to the bowl and stir until just combined, the batter should still be slightly lumpy.
Fold in the mushroom duxelles and grated carrot.
Place the cedar plank on the grill and brush with unsalted butter.
Spoon the cornmeal mixture onto the cedar plank, shaping into a rectangular shape.
Close the grill lid and cook for 20 minutes, or until the cornmeal is golden brown and crispy.
Flip the cornmeal grill over and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the cornmeal grill from the grill and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
